verdict.rationale: Homebrew ships pre-built 'bottles' that are downloaded and installed automatically instead of building from source, which is the core mechanism enabling faster installs (homebrew-docs-8/40), and community commentary notes real perf gains from optimizations like Bootsnap (homebrew-comm-19) and a recent 'pleasant' upgrade session (homebrew-comm-8). However, there is no documented CI-specific cache-restore workflow (e.g. a GitHub Actions guide for restoring the Cellar/bottle cache) and no explicit documentation of offline-capable installs — bottles still require network access to fetch unless a cache is manually preserved, which isn't covered in the evidence. missing for 10: official CI cache-restore recipe/action docs, explicit offline-mode/air-gapped install documentation, independent benchmarking of CI install speed.
